errors.text: The proposed interstitial-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target intervention of varying crystallographic loading direction, temperature, and high strain rate in single-crystal FCC FeNiCrMn.
The stated strain-rate boundary of 10^-4 to 10^-2 s^-1 is quasistatic rather than dynamic and does not support claims about high-rate strength-ductility performance.
The proposed compression and damping experiment does not directly measure tensile ductility or the target high-rate deformation response.
The predicted 10-20% yield-strength and 5-10% elongation increases are not established by the cited evidence.
Evidence E1 concerns substitutional Cr addition and E2 concerns processing and oxidation, so neither directly supports strengthening by oxygen or nitrogen interstitial complexes.
